topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I reckon the Lord has His reasons for the turnin' of the seasons, just as He has for the secrets that come spillin' out when they shouldn’t. Found my Leah’s bucket list, I did, hid away like a seed in hard ground, waitin’ for the thaw. Wasn’t nothin’ grand, her wishes—just simple things, like watchin’ the sunrise from the hill, or dancin’ under a moonlit sky. I always thought she had all she needed, here in our little plot, with the earth and sky and me. Now, I find myself wanderin’ the fields at dusk, linin’ up stones where the wheat once grew, makin’ sense of somethin’ that don’t seem to have any.
